name: Hamed
description: Man with round black glasses, grey-black beard, hoop earring, beige and blue cap; white open shirt over white tee, black wide trousers, brown sneakers. Sheet: two face views, profile with a white cat, feature close-ups, front and back full body.

name: Zahhak
description: Masked king. Cracked copper-red face mask, tall spiked bone-and-metal crown, long grey-black hair, floor-length black velvet robe. V01 black snakes coiled at shoulders + plain staff; V02 dragon-embroidered robe + old-wood staff; V03 dragon-embroidered robe + cobra staff. Mask, crown and silhouette are constant across all three. (copied from SHM CHR-001)

name: Palace Guards
description: Completely featureless pale stone egg-shaped heads, no eyes or mouth. Dark blue-black quilted coats with small dagger loops. Distinct from GRP-004: no carved features, no shields, no spears. (copied from SHM GRP-005)

name: Jamshid
description: White mask carved with gold sunburst rosettes, long straight black hair, gold five-point crown, red-and-cream block-print robe over floral lining. Photographed in a pale stone niche. (copied from SHM CHR-002)

name: Zahhak Hall
description: Vast ceremonial hall of Zahhak. Dark rust-stained walls, a single vertical slit of light above a small stepped dais, scattered standing candles on a wide pale floor. (copied from SHM LOC-024)

name: Theater Hall
description: Ornate old theatre auditorium in low light: gilded arches, box seats, balcony, rows of red seats with small aisle lights, glowing curtain and a shaft of light from a high window.

name: Az
description: Masked figure in a pointed steel mail coif covering the face, dark indigo denim tunic with belt, wide baggy denim trousers and worn brown leather boots. Sheet: headshot, two three-quarter views, mail, stitching and boot details.

name: Gilded Lion Armchair
description: Carved gilded wood armchair with lion-head armrests and pink and blue Persian rug upholstery. Design sheet: front, side and back views, lion head detail, fabric sample, dimensions.
